title: Strait of Hormuz, Oct 19 - New footage of the explosion and fire in the engine room of a non-compliant oil tanker after it struck a naval mine south of the Strait of Hormuz.
text:
Strait of Hormuz, Oct 19 - New footage of the explosion and fire in the engine room of a non-compliant oil tanker after it struck a naval mine south of the Strait of Hormuz."
" "

"———"

"A non-compliant oil tanker struck a mine south of the Strait of Hormuz"
" "
"Public Relations of the Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps:"
" "
"🔹 A non-compliant oil tanker struck a naval mine in the area south of the Strait of Hormuz, causing an explosion and fire in its engine room."
" "
"🔹 This vessel, which intended to exit the Strait of Hormuz, had switched off all of its positioning and navigation systems from the start of its voyage and, disregarding the regulations of the Strait of Hormuz, attempted to pass through the unauthorized southern route of the Strait, where it suffered this accident."
" "
"🔹 The IRGC Navy announces: If vessels transiting the area of the Strait of Hormuz and the Persian Gulf switch off their navigation and identification systems, they will be dealt with severely and decisively.
